propositions: The session-scoped run_request_sites fixture has 46-49s setup cost per Ubuntu CI cell due to repeated AST traversals for parent/caller discovery.
The _enclosing and _verdict helpers rebuild parent maps and rescan the entire cached source tree for every lookup rather than indexing once.

AST parsing is cached but parent-child and call-site relationships are recomputed millions of times (9.54M ast.walk iterations, 130.9M calls), yielding identical 24 ordered (key, expression, verdict) tuples.
An immutable process-local _AstIndex must index parents, enclosing functions, and call sites once from cached parsed trees to eliminate whole-tree rediscovery.
All 24 existing provenance tuples, guard verdicts, and behavioral coverage must remain unchanged after indexing; a deterministic oracle must fail if whole-tree rediscovery is reintroduced.
